[[File:Serianan_Belt.jpg|thumb|right|The Serianan Belt]]
The '''Serianan Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located in the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Korren Starchaser]] led a team from the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]] to the Serianan system, where they discovered [[Theoretical Serias species|alien]] artifacts within a large cave in one of the belt's [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. They named the cave [[the Gulch]].<ref name="Rogue One">''{{JournalCite|8|Scouts' Dispatch}}''</ref>
